claims.gist: Choosing a vendor is hard because products describe themselves in different terms
Analysts verify vendor claims through demonstrations, references and testing where feasible
Start with your own weights, since default weights reflect a typical buyer
Shortlist three to five vendors, then test finalists against your own use cases
No evaluation replaces a proof of concept in your own environment
Scores reflect a product's state at review time, and vendors change quickly
The firm does not accept payment for inclusion or favorable placement

thesis: Vendor evaluations give consistent scoring; buyers should reweight criteria and validate finalists with their own proofs of concept.
